no-check-stmt:
CLASS zcl_test_no_check_in_loop DEFINITION
  PUBLIC FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_001.
    METHODS test_002.
    METHODS test_003.
    METHODS test_004.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_test_no_check_in_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_001.
    DATA lv_flag TYPE abap_bool.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE string_table.
    DATA ls_row TYPE string.
    LOOP AT lt_tab INTO ls_row.
      CHECK lv_flag = abap_true.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_002.
    DATA lv_flag TYPE abap_bool.
    CHECK lv_flag = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_003.
    DATA lv_flag TYPE abap_bool.
    DO 5 TIMES.
      CHECK lv_flag = abap_true.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_004.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE string_table.
    DATA ls_row TYPE string.
    LOOP AT lt_tab INTO ls_row.
      IF ls_row IS INITIAL.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
no-yoda-cond:
CLASS zcl_test_no_yoda_conditions DEFINITION
  PUBLIC FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_001.
    METHODS test_002.
    METHODS test_003.
    METHODS test_004.
    METHODS test_005.
    METHODS test_006.
    METHODS test_007.
    METHODS test_008.
    METHODS test_009.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_no_yoda_conditions IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_001.
    DATA lv_code TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    IF 'X' = lv_code.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_002.
    DATA lv_code TYPE c LENGTH 1.
    IF lv_code = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_003.
    DATA lv_num TYPE i.
    IF 0 = lv_num.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_004.
    DATA lv_num TYPE i.
    IF lv_num <> 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_005.
    DATA table TYPE i.
    IF 0 = table.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_006.
    IF 'A' = 'B'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_007.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE string_table.
    IF 0 = lines( lt_tab ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_008.
    DATA lv_str TYPE string.
    IF '-1' = lv_str.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_009.
    DATA lv_str TYPE string.
    IF 'foo' CS lv_str.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
no-select-star:
CLASS zcl_test_no_select_star DEFINITION
  PUBLIC FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_001.
    METHODS test_002.
    METHODS test_003.
    METHODS test_004.
    METHODS test_005.
    METHODS test_006.
    METHODS test_007.
    METHODS test_008.
    METHODS test_009.
    METHODS test_010.
    METHODS test_011.
    METHODS test_012.
    METHODS test_013.
    METHODS test_014.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_test_no_select_star IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_001.
    SELECT * FROM t100 INTO @DATA(ls_row).
    ENDSELECT.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_002.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT arbgb FROM t100 INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_003.
    DATA ls_row TYPE t100.
    DATA ls_key TYPE string.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM t100 INTO @ls_row WHERE arbgb = @ls_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_004.
    DATA ls_row TYPE t100.
    DATA ls_key TYPE string.
    SELECT SINGLE arbgb FROM t100 INTO @ls_row WHERE arbgb = @ls_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_005.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT FROM t100 FIELDS * INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_006.
    DATA lv_val TYPE i.
    SELECT SINGLE price * 2 FROM sflight INTO @lv_val.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_007.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT tab~* FROM t100 AS tab INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_008.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT FROM t100 FIELDS arbgb INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_009.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT FROM t100 FIELDS * WHERE ( sprsl = 'E' ) INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_010.
    DATA lv_total TYPE i.
    SELECT SINGLE ( price * 2 ) AS total FROM sflight INTO @lv_total.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_011.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT msgnr FROM t100 WHERE msgnr IN ( SELECT msgnr FROM t100 WHERE ( sprsl = 'E' ) ) INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_012.
    DATA lv_dummy TYPE i.
    SELECT FROM t100 AS a JOIN t100 AS b ON a~msgnr = b~msgnr FIELDS a~*, b~text INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_join).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_013.
    DATA lt_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t100 WITH DEFAULT KEY.
    SELECT FROM t100 AS a
      INNER JOIN t100 AS b ON ( a~msgnr = b~msgnr AND a~sprsl = b~sprsl )
      FIELDS a~arbgb, b~msgnr
      INTO TABLE @lt_tab.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_014.
    DATA lv_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM t100 INTO @lv_count WHERE ( sprsl = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
no-magic-numbers:
CLASS zcl_test_no_magic_numbers DEFINITION
  PUBLIC FINAL
  CREATE PUBLIC.

  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS test_001.
    METHODS test_002.
    METHODS test_003.
    METHODS test_004.
    METHODS test_005.
    DATA iv_spras TYPE string.
    DATA rv_spras TYPE string.
    METHODS language_sap1_to_sap2
      IMPORTING im_lang_sap1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING VALUE(re_lang_sap2) TYPE string
      EXCEPTIONS no_assignment.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_test_no_magic_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD language_sap1_to_sap2.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_001.
    DATA lv_val TYPE i.
    lv_val = 42.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_002.
    DATA lv_val TYPE i.
    lv_val = 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_003.
    DATA lv_val TYPE i.
    IF lv_val > 100.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_004.
    CONSTANTS c_limit TYPE i VALUE 10.
    DATA lv_val TYPE i.
    lv_val = c_limit.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_005.
    language_sap1_to_sap2(
      EXPORTING
        im_lang_sap1  = iv_spras
      RECEIVING
        re_lang_sap2  = rv_spras
      EXCEPTIONS
        no_assignment = 1
        OTHERS        = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
